title: Redesign the Android application icon
scope: User selected implementation of UX-006, DEV-013 and UI-034 together. Icon direction: round default accent/primary background and Font Awesome page-and-pen artwork.
expected: Prepare and review a recognizable QShopper application icon, then supply the Android assets needed by the selected design.
review_points: Agree the visual direction with the user; the request does not yet specify a motif, palette or preferred style.
Check current official Android launcher/adaptive/themed-icon requirements when implementation begins.
Assess recognition and legibility at small sizes, across launcher masks and Light/Dark backgrounds.
Record asset provenance/licensing and verify packaged resources plus actual launcher appearance.

validation.static: tests/test_launcher_icon.py passes source/path, all six PNG dimensions/colors/alpha, safe-circle and manifest/resource checks.
validation.native: tests/android/test_icon.py passes installed version 0.1.0/code 2, actual native AdaptiveIconDrawable mask/background/foreground/monochrome. Native Settings icon screenshot visually inspected; foreground preserves the pen descender. Reports: out/ux006-dev013-ui034/android-icon-final.
validation.packaging: Both APK version/runtime-payload contracts pass: 53 native libraries per ABI, dependency closure intact, no QML tooling/test/unused payload. Reports: out/ux006-dev013-ui034/package-arm64.json and package-x86.json.
validation.limits: API 36 emulator verified. Physical-phone/user acceptance and other launcher masks are not claimed. Play Store listing assets and production signing remain REL-001.

user_decision: Round Green accent (#69F0AE, the default Dark palette) with dark Font Awesome Free Solid 7.3.1 file-pen. No font migration or in-app palette change.
implementation: Pinned original SVG, provenance/hash, editable round SVG, six transparent PNG densities and Android adaptive vector foreground/background plus API 33 monochrome. Manifest uses matching normal/round resources. CMake stages all drawable qualifiers. Updated bundled Font Awesome attribution and regeneration tool retain CC BY 4.0 terms.
